figures.title: French consumer sentiment ends this chart just under the 85 line
figures.analysis: One orange line plots a consumer-sentiment index. The vertical scale runs from 75 to 105, with a gridline every five points. The horizontal scale runs from 2014 through 2026. The line peaks near the top gridline twice, once late in the 2010s and once near 2021, then drops to the 80 gridline in 2022. It climbs back toward the low 90s around 2024 and then falls, finishing just under the 85 gridline, where a short purple tick marks the last reading. The footnote names the national statistics institute as the source.

marketTone: Tuesday's crude settle fell again while Gulf talks stayed in the lead, and US indexes rose for a second day. WTI settled at 99.90 and Brent at 113.88. The 10-year yield was 4.9843%. Shanghai fell 1.33% to 3648.30 and ChiNext fell 3.41%. The chart is a French consumer-sentiment index finishing just under the 85 line.

summary.text: 华尔街见闻: the S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7722.60, the Nasdaq rose 1.18% to 26477.81, and the Dow rose 0.03% to 52377.57. CNBC printed the same closes.
华尔街见闻: December WTI fell 1.83% to 99.90 and December Brent fell 1.67% to 113.88. CNBC printed the same settles. Spot gold rose 1.09% to 4060.55. The 10-year yield fell 0.41 basis points to 4.9843%.
华尔街见闻: the Shanghai Composite fell 1.33% to 3648.30, Shenzhen fell 2.50% to 11245.73, and ChiNext fell 3.41% to 2548.15. The Hang Seng fell 0.73% to 23041.32 and Hang Seng Tech fell 1.48% to 3800.43.

财新: September industrial profits rose 14.4% from a year earlier, and the January–September total rose 15.5%. 第一财经: the PBOC conducted 4120亿元 of 7-day reverse repos at 1.40% and 10000亿元 overnight, with 3980亿元 maturing.

signal: Brent settled at 113.88 and WTI at 99.90 as the Gulf pullback extended, and the S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7722.60 with another heavily subscribed AI share sale. The 10-year yield was 4.9843%. Shanghai fell 1.33% to 3648.30, so Monday's hold is gone. The chart is French consumer sentiment just under the 85 line.

themeCards.title: Crude fell again as Gulf talks kept the risk premium on the back foot
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：WTI 12月合约跌1.83%报99.90美元/桶，布伦特12月合约跌1.67%报113.88美元/桶。 财经早茶：油价继续回落，交易员权衡波斯湾局势降温迹象，并等待以色列大选结果。
themeCards.mechanism: Talks extended the crude drop, and a strike on a Saudi export terminal did not turn the settle around. CICC (30 June): the low-inventory mark left by the Strait shock is hard to erase and can hold a higher floor under oil. Oil carries the 99.90 WTI settle and the 113.88 Brent settle. The theme changes if those talks break and Brent rises back through 113.88.
themeCards.trigger: WTI at 99.90 and Brent at 113.88 as Gulf cooling extended the drop.
themeCards.invalidator: The talks break and Brent rises back through 113.88.

themeCards.title: The Treasury curve flattened again and the 10-year stayed under 5%
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：10年期收益率跌0.41个基点报4.9843%，2年期涨1.27个基点报4.7286%，30年期跌0.53个基点报5.2975%。 财经早茶：5年期国债标售后收益率曲线走平，美联储宣布利率决议前夕市场波动有限。
themeCards.mechanism: The curve flattened because the two-year yield rose and the thirty-year yield fell, while the ten-year yield stayed under 5%. CICC (24 October): in their October investor survey, haven assets were still the main allocation, and a larger share of respondents wanted to extend duration. Treasuries carry the 4.9843% ten-year yield and the 4.7286% two-year yield. The theme changes if the ten-year yield closes at 5% or higher.
themeCards.trigger: A 10-year yield of 4.9843% that stayed under 5%, with the 2-year at 4.7286%, after the 5-year auction.
themeCards.invalidator: The 10-year yield closes at 5% or higher.

themeCards.title: A second equity up day landed on a heavily subscribed AI share sale
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：标普500涨0.60%报7722.60点，纳指涨1.18%报26477.81点。 财经早茶：Meta的250亿美元股票发行交易据悉获得五倍认购。
themeCards.mechanism: A second up day landed on a share sale that found five times the demand, so the financing for this build got larger. CICC (22 September): overseas AI capital spending is still growing, but the pace may slow from the fourth quarter. US equities carry the 0.60% S&P rise to 7722.60 and the 1.18% Nasdaq rise to 26477.81. The theme changes if that share sale is pulled or those two indexes give back this rise.
themeCards.trigger: The S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7722.60 and the Nasdaq rose 1.18% to 26477.81 as a 250亿美元 share sale drew five times demand.
themeCards.invalidator: The share sale is pulled or the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq give back this rise.

themeCards.title: Shanghai gave back Monday's hold and ChiNext fell again
themeCards.mechanism: The small Shanghai hold did not last a second session, and the growth board fell harder than the benchmark. CICC (19 October): in the latest choppy stretch, the broad equity ETFs they track saw net inflows pick up again. A-shares carry the 1.33% drop to 3648.30 and the 3.41% ChiNext drop to 2548.15. The old hold is finished unless Shanghai closes back above 3648.30 and ChiNext rises.
themeCards.trigger: Shanghai fell 1.33% to 3648.30 and ChiNext fell 3.41% to 2548.15.
themeCards.invalidator: Shanghai closes back above 3648.30 and ChiNext rises.

themeCards.title: Spot gold bounced back through 4000 while yields barely moved
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：现货黄金涨1.09%报4060.55美元，重新站上4000美元。 财经早茶：逢低买盘推动黄金反弹。
themeCards.mechanism: Gold rose on a day yields barely moved and equities rose, so this bounce stands apart from the Treasury tape. Morgan Stanley (28 October): gold has failed as a hedge in sharp equity selloffs since 2020, while it has cushioned violent Treasury selloffs, and the bank still prefers gold among metals. Gold carries the 1.09% rise in the spot price to 4060.55. The theme changes if spot gold falls back through 4060.55.
themeCards.trigger: Spot gold rose 1.09% to 4060.55 and moved back through 4000.

themeCards.title: The cash premium in copper jumped to a two-month high
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：LME期铜涨147美元，报14,474美元/吨，现货较三个月期铜的溢价升至每吨206美元。 财经早茶：伦敦现货铜较期铜的溢价飙升至两个月来最高水平，显示短期供应压力加剧。
themeCards.mechanism: The cash contract's premium over three-month copper is a shortage of metal now, which is a different force from the gold bounce. CICC (13 October): mine supply growth over the next few years still struggles to match demand, and the tight balance has not changed. Copper carries the 14,474 dollar LME price and the 206 dollar cash premium. The theme changes if that cash premium falls back and the backwardation disappears.
themeCards.trigger: LME copper at 14,474 dollars a tonne, with the cash premium at 206 dollars, the highest in two months.
themeCards.invalidator: The cash premium over three-month copper falls back from 206 dollars.

themeCards.title: French consumer sentiment fell to a 13-year low
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：受债券抛售潮及社会动荡冲击，法国10月消费者信心指数降至13年低点。
themeCards.mechanism: A 13-year low in the confidence index is the household side of the bond selloff and the unrest. CICC (12 October): the concessions required to pass the budget can limit how far the premium comes back. OATs do not get a fresh yield on this tape, so the exposure is the confidence index itself. The theme changes if the index turns up from this low or a named budget deal passes.
themeCards.trigger: French consumer confidence at a 13-year low on the October print.
themeCards.invalidator: The index turns up from this low, or a named budget deal passes.

themeCards.title: Japan's core inflation gauge accelerated to 3.2%
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：剔除生鲜食品及特殊因素后的9月消费者价格同比上涨3.2%，8月为2.6%。
themeCards.mechanism: A 3.2% core reading, up from 2.6%, is faster inflation than the prior month, and the hike path is the rates question under it. CICC (17 June): the bank raised its policy rate at that meeting and said further hikes were still ahead. The yen does not get a separate settle on this tape, so the exposure is that inflation print. The theme changes if the core measure is revised back to 2.6% or lower.
themeCards.trigger: The BOJ-style core index at 3.2% in September, up from 2.6%.
themeCards.invalidator: That core measure is revised back to 2.6% or lower.

globalRegime: Tuesday extended the crude pullback and gave US indexes a second up day, with an AI share sale that drew heavy demand. The Treasury curve flattened again and the 10-year yield stayed under 5%. Shanghai gave back Monday's hold. Spot gold rose back through 4000, and the cash premium in copper widened. The chart is French consumer sentiment at a 13-year low.

globalChanged.text: 财经早茶：美东时间周三下午美联储将公布利率决定，普遍预计决策者将按兵不动，12月可能进行今年第二次加息。
财经早茶：伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊重申结束对美战争的前提条件。中国外交部表示将向该地区派遣特使，防止局势进一步恶化。
财经早茶：特朗普政府计划向竞选巴西总统失败的博索纳罗发放签证，博索纳罗据报已经抵美，巴西当局正在调查其竞选是否获得非法外国资助，其中包括一个与美国副总统万斯有关的团体。
财经早茶：世界大型企业联合会数据显示，美国10月消费者信心指数四个月来首次上升，受访者对就业和商业环境看法改善。

财经早茶：民调显示，民主党可能从共和党手中夺取国会两院中至少一院的控制权，美债市场质疑此类“分裂政府”或无助于遏制财政赤字。
财经早茶：以色列大选出口民调显示，反对派领导人埃森科特略微领先现任总理内塔尼亚胡。计票工作仍在进行，最终结果可能发生变化。
财经早茶：亿万富豪Novogratz称，全球信贷市场对AI支出的焦虑或许已接近顶峰，之后市场将逐步趋稳。Meta的250亿美元股票发行交易据悉获得五倍认购。
财经早茶：甲骨文将在AI云服务中引入Cerebras计算机，甲骨文云基础设施将从2027年上半年开始部署这些设备。
财经早茶：苹果推出新款24英寸iMac和配备14英寸屏幕的入门级MacBook Pro。周三该公司将揭晓MacBook Pro高端触屏款。
财经早茶：受债券抛售潮及社会动荡冲击，法国10月消费者信心指数降至13年低点。
财经早茶：通用汽车计划11月17日起将上市地点从纽约证交所迁至纳斯达克，股票代码仍为GM。
财经早茶：Two Sigma两位创始人据悉考虑出售部分股份，以解决长期不和造成的决策僵局。
财经早茶：Millennium据悉探索利用Polymarket等预测市场的数据来协助制定交易策略。
华尔街见闻：胡塞武装袭击沙特石油出口终端拉斯塔努拉，沙特防空系统拦截来袭导弹与无人机，油价跌势没有因此转回。

globalImplies.text: If the Gulf talks break, the drop from 113.88 can reverse, and the low-inventory floor is the part that remains.
If the AI share sale is pulled, Tuesday's equity bounce was a subscription headline and the financing worry is back in the lead.
If the ten-year yield closes at 5% or higher, the flat curve under 5% is done.

globalTensions: Crude settled lower while spot gold rose. US indexes rose while the ten-year yield barely moved. Shanghai fell and ChiNext fell harder, with banks the names that rose on the breakfast tape. The dollar index rose for a third day on the mail while gold rose. Conference Board confidence rose in the United States while the French confidence index on the chart fell to a 13-year low.
chinaStance: The Fifth Plenum is still in session through 29 October. Caixin says the draft decision is on party discipline. September industrial profits rose 14.4%, and the year-to-date total rose 15.5%, while ChiNext fell 3.41%. On 27 October the PBOC rolled a large overnight reverse repo alongside the 7-day operation at 1.40%. No 28 October yuan fix was on 第一财经 at publish time. The onshore yuan on the breakfast tape was 6.6670 at 03:00 Beijing.

chinaChanged.text: 财经早茶：美国可能将针对中国关联船舶的港口停靠费暂停措施延长两个月，目前正在与北京方面进行接触。
财经早茶：印刷电路板制造商东山精密周三将登陆港交所，这是香港近两个月规模最大的上市交易，发行价定为每股86.8港元，公开发售未获足额认购。
财经早茶：美国监管部门告知TP-Link，其部分Wi-Fi路由器违反功率水平限制，此举可能为进一步禁止该公司的设备铺平道路。
财经早茶：在多家中企宣布终止合作后，法国足球明星基利安·姆巴佩就其被认为侮辱毛泽东的争议言论道歉。
财经早茶：随着中国与菲律宾的领土争端加剧，北京将降低本周赴菲律宾参加东盟防长扩大会的代表级别。
财经早茶：台湾上月货币供应量年增率上升，外汇存款首度突破10兆元台币。
财经早茶：韩国SK海力士旗下闪存公司Solidigm据悉拟投资450亿美元新建美国芯片厂，但要求华府同意其先升级中国设施。
财经早茶：泡泡玛特预计上季度销售额同比下降45%-50%，受Labubu热度减退及去年比较基数较高等因素影响。
第一财经：10月27日央行开展4120亿元7天期逆回购，操作利率1.40%，并开展10000亿元隔夜逆回购，当日3980亿元到期。

财新：中共二十届五中全会10月26日上午在北京开始举行，会期至10月29日。讨论稿是关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党。

chinaImplies.text: If the plenum text stays on party discipline, the profit print does not hand growth boards a stimulus bid.
If the overnight reverse repo stays this large beside a 7-day operation at 1.40%, the stance is still ample liquidity.
If ChiNext stays down while industrial profits are up 14.4%, the profit print and the equity tape are two different stories.

chinaDivergences: Industrial profits rose 14.4% and ChiNext fell 3.41%. Banks rose on the breakfast tape while the growth boards fell. The onshore yuan was 6.6670 at 03:00 Beijing on that tape, and a 28 October fix was not on 第一财经. The plenum draft is about party discipline while the PBOC's latest operation is a large overnight liquidity add.
